title: Benchmarks that mean something
brief: Compute TTFT, ITL, throughput, and goodput, generate Poisson load, show coordinated omission on a stalled server, drive an engine in process, and find the knee of a goodput sweep.
hints: Inter-token latency spans the gaps between tokens, so a run of n tokens has n - 1 gaps.
Poisson arrivals means exponential gaps: -ln(U) / rate for U uniform on (0, 1].
Goodput counts only the requests that met the target, not all of them.
A closed-loop client waits for each reply, so a stall costs it one slow sample. Measure the open-loop client from the intended send time, not from when it actually got to send.
The knee is the largest rate before the first rate whose goodput drops below the threshold. Stop at the first miss.
